sample_normalized_row.case_title: GOVIND BHAT Vs OXFORD REALTY LLP
summaries: The complaint was filed by the complainant before the MahaRERA authority regarding the project P52100003129.
The flat was booked by the complainant in the registered project.
The allotment letter was issued to the complainant on March 29 2016.
The possession was promised to be delivered as per the agreement.
The complainant paid a consideration amount for the flat in the project.
The complainant sought refund of the amount paid after cancellation.
The occupancy certificate was obtained by the promoter on July 27 2019.
The complainant sought refund of the amount paid after cancellation.
The respondent filed a reply and appeared through an advocate.
The evidence submitted included the allotment letter and cancellation form.
The authority examined the project registration P52100003129.
The authority considered the RERA provisions regarding promoter and allottee duties.
The delay or breach was not determined as the allotment was terminated.
The complainant requested refund of the amount paid after cancellation.
The authority analyzed the legal obligations of the parties under RERA.
The authority recorded the submissions of both parties regarding the dispute.
The authority applied the relevant sections of RERA for the disposal.
The final finding recorded was that the complaint is dismissed.
The relief granted was the dismissal of the complaint.
The proceedings were closed by the authority on July 04 2023.
